title: Cumulative Frequency, Quartiles and Percentiles
seo_title: Cumulative Frequency – SSS 2 Mathematics Worksheets with Answers (NERDC)
standard_text: Draw and read cumulative frequency curves (ogives); find the median, quartiles, interquartile range and percentiles; draw box plots. (summary of the NERDC SSS 2 Mathematics curriculum)
meta_desc: Free SSS 2 maths worksheets on cumulative frequency: ogives, median, quartiles, interquartile range, percentiles and box plots. 100 questions with answers.
key_big: Median at n/2 on the ogive
body_html:
How to think about it

  • Add the frequencies as you go to make the cumulative frequency.
  • Plot each cumulative frequency at the upper class boundary and join with a smooth curve.
  • Read the median at n/2, Q₁ at n/4 and Q₃ at 3n/4.

Examples

Example

n = 80 on an ogive

Median at 40

Answer: Q₁ at 20, Q₃ at 60

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Plotting at the class markPlot at the upper boundary.
IQR = Q₃ + Q₁IQR = Q₃ − Q₁.
Reading the y-axis value as the answerRead across to the curve, then down.
